restaurant.name: RestoKu
restaurant.tagline: Authentic Asian & Local Fusion Street Food
restaurant.description: Authentic local flavors served fresh daily. Scan, order, and enjoy!

items.name: Nasi Goreng Spesial
items.description: Wok-tossed Indonesian fried rice with shredded chicken, sunny-side-up egg, chicken satay, and crispy prawn crackers.

items.name: Nasi Goreng Ikan Asin
items.description: Aromatic fried rice tossed with crispy salted fish, leeks, garlic, and fresh bird's eye chili.

items.name: Japanese Curry Rice
items.description: Rich, comforting golden Japanese curry with tender carrots, potatoes, and fluffy warm steamed rice.

items.name: Nasi Campur Bali
items.description: Fragrant steamed rice served with shredded spiced chicken, sambal matah, green beans lawar, and boiled egg.

items.name: Kwetiau Goreng Sapi 79
items.description: Signature wok-charred flat rice noodles stir-fried with tender beef slices, egg, bean sprouts, and dark sweet soy.

items.name: Mie Goreng Jawa
items.description: Traditional Javanese stir-fried egg noodles with shredded chicken, sweet cabbage, tomatoes, and aromatic garlic.

items.name: Bakmi Ayam Jamur
items.description: Springy homemade egg noodles tossed with savory soy-braised chicken and shiitake mushrooms, served with clear broth.

items.name: Spicy Beef Chili Ramen
items.description: Rich slow-simmered savory broth with bouncy noodles, braised beef brisket, soft-boiled egg, and homemade chili oil.

items.name: Ayam Goreng Bawang Putih
items.description: Deep-fried golden chicken marinated in herbs and topped with crispy whole roasted garlic cloves and fresh cilantro.

items.name: Chicken Tikka Masala
items.description: Tender marinated chicken chunks simmered in a luscious creamy tomato and aromatic butter sauce.

items.name: Ayam Cabe Garam
items.description: Crisp bite-sized chicken tossed in a fiery wok with minced red chili, roasted garlic, spring onion, and sea salt.

items.name: Chicken Katsu Set
items.description: Golden Japanese panko-breaded chicken cutlet with shredded cabbage, sesame dressing, and savory tonkatsu glaze.

items.name: Ayam Bakar Madu
items.description: Char-grilled chicken thigh glazed with sweet blossom honey, lime, and rich caramelized dark soy sauce.

items.name: Rendang Daging Sapi Padang
items.description: Tender beef shank slow-cooked for 6 hours in rich coconut milk and freshly ground Minang spices until caramelized.

items.name: Black Pepper Beef
items.description: Tender beef strips wok-fried with crisp bell peppers, sweet onions, and a punchy crushed Sarawak black pepper sauce.

items.name: Wagyu Beef Gyudon
items.description: Thinly shaved premium beef and sweet caramelized onions simmered in savory dashi-mirin broth over rice with onsen egg.

items.name: Rawon Daging Surabaya
items.description: Traditional East Javanese black beef soup brewed with roasted kluwek nuts, served with salted duck egg and sambal.

items.name: Cah Kangkung Terasi
items.description: Fresh water spinach quick-seared in high wok heat with fragrant fermented shrimp paste, red chili, and garlic.

items.name: Tumis Tauge Ikan Asin
items.description: Crisp bean sprouts stir-fried with crunchy salted fish morsels, leeks, and sliced red chili.

items.name: Capcay Seafood Kuah
items.description: Colorful vegetable medley of crisp broccoli, sweet carrots, baby corn, and mushrooms braised in savory garlic broth.

items.name: Crispy Enoki Cabe Garam
items.description: Golden tempura enoki mushrooms tossed with crispy garlic, chopped bird's eye chili, and toasted aromatic seasoning.

items.name: Es Teh Manis Jasmine
items.description: Chilled premium brewed loose-leaf jasmine tea served over ice with organic cane sugar.

items.name: Es Jeruk Peras Murni
items.description: Freshly squeezed sweet Pontianak tangerines served chilled with crushed ice.

items.name: Iced Uji Matcha Latte
items.description: Creamy ceremonial grade Japanese matcha whisked with fresh whole milk and lightly sweetened.

items.name: Lychee Sparkling Cooler
items.description: Refreshing sparkling soda infused with sweet lychee syrup, fresh mint sprigs, and real whole lychees.

items.name: Es Cendol Gula Aren
items.description: Traditional iced refreshment with pandan rice flour jelly, rich coconut milk, and smoky palm sugar syrup.
